topic: Near32 defect bookkeeping, unequal-radius clique core geometry and packet source-localization
theory_before_calculation: For a finite Besicovitch witness cover, 32m-lambda|E| splits exactly into receiver-volume defect, average slack and multiplicity defect; near32 forces source onto the disjoint 32-fold clique cores.

Any 32 intersecting Besicovitch cubes, with arbitrary radii and centers, have common core width <max radius in each coordinate, via adjacent orthant pairs. This gives the whole-mass local receiver constant127/4, not a global C5 bound.

Descending-radius greedy assignment localizes each receiver witness to twice its assigned cube. The resulting dilated packet source sets can overlap without a uniform geometric bound; weighted source congestion and witness slack must both be tracked.
